R2 registerDoctypes calls register once per type in R1's order, and registers nothing the second time
R3 every type takes its local facts from ctx.view, and with no view from every non-test held profile
R4 each type declares a contract, SUBSTANCE or MEMBERSHIP, generic SUBSTANCE
R5 every event a type's assess emits is the catalogue's, and meaningful is isMeaningful(events)
R6 every connection is referential or temporal, each in its own shape
R7 a type places a reference only where locate says, once per reference with every occurrence, and no source without a locator
R8 the calendar's forward-looking connection reads ctx.now when given, the wall clock only when not
R3 R8 the minutes-due date is the profile's practice counted by civil-time: business days on the profile's own closures
R18 the existing fixtures of every type give the verdicts docprofile gave, apart from the added readings
R20 no place is named in this module's code, and every type is read under a profile that is not the first
R21 deterministic over its inputs apart from R8, and nothing reads a store or the network
R22 an unrecognised document is never assumed decorated, and a type without CERTAIN never asserts unchanged
R23 a reading or a diff that found nothing is a failed reader, and a mass removal is never reported from one
R24 every no says which no and why
R4 R5 R1 a registry filled by registerDoctypes answers as docprofile's did: first CERTAIN, else best, else generic
R39 a 1,500-character recommendation is read whole to the next heading
R39 a recommendation spread over many lines is read whole and stops at the next heading
R39 a recommendation with no heading after it is cut at the stated bound and says so, with its full length
R39 a short recommendation is unchanged, and none found is still null
R9 form is instrument or code; a code section is CERTAIN only on a heading of a code the view names, then a title
R10 sections are one entry per section in document order, {path, number, heading, start, end, source}, nested extents
R11 numbers, separators and marker order come from the view; SECTION n. is place-free; nothing divides to no sections, with why
R12 a per-section document gives its one section with exact boundaries; a charter article gives each of its sections
R13 definitions: each passage in the definitional voice, {term, start, end, source, section}, a term defined twice twice
R14 exceptions: each passage that excepts, {start, end, source, section, cites}, cites read by the view's forms
R15 definitions and exceptions are readings, never law relations: nothing records defines or excepts
R16 a section whose heading, text, definitions or exceptions moved, or present on one side, gives instrument_changed naming it
R17 tested on the captured codifier sections and charter articles, with their provenance, every boundary exact
R19 sections, definitions and exceptions each carry a stated count, and an unplaced passage is listed with section null and why
